title: 光子與電子晶片共同設計
summary: 從驅動器、調變器、光偵測器和 TIA 的共同負載拆成 4 階段、24 項可保存的工程作業；包含物理模型、算例、可區分失效的量測與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 saveable work packages investigate joint driver, modulator, photodetector and TIA loading, including physical models, a worked example, discriminating measurements and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的概念設計與資料判讀課，非供應商配方或可直接投產的操作程序。算例全部是教學假設；真正驗收須使用適用版本、合格設備與實測參數。代表照片、示意圖與影片不宣稱為每步製造實拍。
scopeEn: Conceptual design and data interpretation from public principles, not a vendor recipe or production-ready procedure. All worked inputs are educational assumptions. Real acceptance requires the applicable revision, qualified equipment and measured parameters. Representative media are not claimed as footage of every operation.

stages.title: 參考面與頻寬
stages.description: 以三個技術單元檢查「參考面與頻寬」，每一單元交付設計模型及獨立判別證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units examine reference planes and bandwidth, each delivering a model and independent diagnostic evidence.

steps.title: 介面參考面：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Interface reference planes: model and design
steps.objective: 以「介面參考面」建立可檢驗的物理模型，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for interface reference planes, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「介面參考面」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。EIC 的輸出端和 PIC 電極入口之間含封裝寄生，不能直接把兩條理想曲線相接。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「定義電光共同參考面及量測去嵌入檔，核對阻抗。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for interface reference planes, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Package parasitics sit between the EIC output and PIC electrode; ideal standalone curves cannot simply be concatenated. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Define shared reference planes/de-embedding and audit impedances. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances.
steps.observation: 定義電光共同參考面及量測去嵌入檔，核對阻抗。
steps.observationEn: Define shared reference planes/de-embedding and audit impedances.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：總鏈路頻寬永遠等於最慢元件的標稱頻寬。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Total link bandwidth always equals the slowest rated component. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交介面參考面的兩狀態模型、變數表，以及能由「定義電光共同參考面及量測去嵌入檔，核對阻抗。」反駁模型的預測。
steps.checkEn: Submit two model states and a variable table for interface reference planes, plus a falsifiable prediction using: Define shared reference planes/de-embedding and audit impedances.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「光子與電子晶片共同設計」的「介面參考面：模型與設計」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出晶粒、基板、接點與量測端的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「熱島救援：模組交付前夜」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與批號、接合位置、熱歷史、接點讀值與顯微圖版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Interface reference planes: model and design” in “Photonic-electronic co-design”. Draw the die, substrate, joint and measurement interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Thermal Island: Before Module Delivery” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for lot, joint location, thermal history, contact readings and micrograph version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 要審查「介面參考面」，哪項主張或驗證方法有根據？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or verification is justified when reviewing interface reference planes?
options: EIC 的輸出端和 PIC 電極入口之間含封裝寄生，不能直接把兩條理想曲線相接。
總鏈路頻寬永遠等於最慢元件的標稱頻寬。
光輸出會讓電返回路徑不再重要。
optionsEn: Package parasitics sit between the EIC output and PIC electrode; ideal standalone curves cannot simply be concatenated.
Total link bandwidth always equals the slowest rated component.
An optical output removes the need for electrical return paths.
quiz.explanation: EIC 的輸出端和 PIC 電極入口之間含封裝寄生，不能直接把兩條理想曲線相接。 定義電光共同參考面及量測去嵌入檔，核對阻抗。
quiz.explanationEn: Package parasitics sit between the EIC output and PIC electrode; ideal standalone curves cannot simply be concatenated. Define shared reference planes/de-embedding and audit impedances.

steps.title: 介面參考面：量測與判別

steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Define shared reference planes/de-embedding and audit impedances. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Package parasitics sit between the EIC output and PIC electrode; ideal standalone curves cannot simply be concatenated." against the incorrect hypothesis "An optical output removes the need for electrical return paths."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model.
steps.observation: 定義電光共同參考面及量測去嵌入檔，核對阻抗。

steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：光輸出會讓電返回路徑不再重要。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: An optical output removes the need for electrical return paths. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交介面參考面的量測判別表：定義電光共同參考面及量測去嵌入檔，核對阻抗。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for interface reference planes: Define shared reference planes/de-embedding and audit impedances. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.

steps.objectiveEn: Build a falsifiable physical model for cascaded bandwidth, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 先以師傅示意確認「頻寬串接」的輸入、輸出與座標，再在學徒工作台完成對應元件或資料流的排列。驅動、調變及接收響應相乘，多個單極點的總頻寬不等於最小單元頻寬。 用本單元的變數畫出至少兩種設計狀態，說明它們在「相乘複數傳遞函數並找總 −3 dB 點，保留相位。」的驗證中應有何差異；把待量測參數另列，不以動畫位置當成實際公差。 假設 lumped 驅動器 R=50 Ω、PIC及封裝總電容 C=100 fF，fRC=1/(2πRC)=31.8 GHz。若接點再加 50 fF，變成 21.2 GHz。這只是一階電 RC，不代表完整電光 3 dB 頻寬；電極分布、光子壽命和接收器尚未加入。
steps.instructionEn: Use the mentor view to identify the inputs, outputs and coordinates for cascaded bandwidth, then arrange the corresponding components or data flow in the apprentice workspace. Driver, modulator and receiver responses multiply; cascaded bandwidth is not simply the smallest component bandwidth. Draw at least two design states using this unit's variables and predict how the following verification distinguishes them: Multiply complex transfers and locate the overall −3 dB point, retaining phase. List unmeasured parameters separately; animation positions are not manufacturing tolerances. Assume a lumped 50 Ω driver and 100 fF total load: fRC=31.8 GHz. Another 50 fF lowers it to 21.2 GHz. This is only a first-order electrical RC limit, not complete electro-optic bandwidth; electrode distribution, photon lifetime and receiver are excluded.

steps.title: 頻寬串接：量測與判別
steps.objective: 以「頻寬串接」區分機制並作出有證據的驗收決定，交付可重算且列明邊界的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Discriminate mechanisms and make an evidence-based acceptance decision for cascaded bandwidth, with reproducible calculations and stated boundaries.
steps.instruction: 保留上一作業的模型，現在檢驗它是否足以解釋觀察。相乘複數傳遞函數並找總 −3 dB 點，保留相位。 記錄原始量、單位、基準與重複量測差異；以支持及否定各一項證據比較「驅動、調變及接收響應相乘，多個單極點的總頻寬不等於最小單元頻寬。」與錯誤假說「總鏈路頻寬永遠等於最慢元件的標稱頻寬。」，最後提出放行、重測或修模決定。 假設 lumped 驅動器 R=50 Ω、PIC及封裝總電容 C=100 fF，fRC=1/(2πRC)=31.8 GHz。若接點再加 50 fF，變成 21.2 GHz。這只是一階電 RC，不代表完整電光 3 dB 頻寬；電極分布、光子壽命和接收器尚未加入。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the previous model and test whether it explains the observations. Multiply complex transfers and locate the overall −3 dB point, retaining phase. Record raw quantities, units, reference conditions and repeatability. Use supporting and falsifying evidence to compare "Driver, modulator and receiver responses multiply; cascaded bandwidth is not simply the smallest component bandwidth." against the incorrect hypothesis "Total link bandwidth always equals the slowest rated component."; decide whether to accept, repeat or revise the model. Assume a lumped 50 Ω driver and 100 fF total load: fRC=31.8 GHz. Another 50 fF lowers it to 21.2 GHz. This is only a first-order electrical RC limit, not complete electro-optic bandwidth; electrode distribution, photon lifetime and receiver are excluded.
steps.observation: 相乘複數傳遞函數並找總 −3 dB 點，保留相位。
steps.observationEn: Multiply complex transfers and locate the overall −3 dB point, retaining phase.
steps.failure: 須排除的錯誤假說：總鏈路頻寬永遠等於最慢元件的標稱頻寬。 若觀察不支持預測，先核對基準與單位，再依本步判別量測定位原因；不能只調參到曲線相合。
steps.failureEn: Incorrect hypothesis to reject: Total link bandwidth always equals the slowest rated component. If observations disagree, first check references and units, then use this step's discriminating measurement; do not simply tune parameters until curves agree.
steps.check: 提交頻寬串接的量測判別表：相乘複數傳遞函數並找總 −3 dB 點，保留相位。 附上基準、重複性或不確定度，及不能由本資料判定的結論。
steps.checkEn: Submit a measurement-discrimination table for cascaded bandwidth: Multiply complex transfers and locate the overall −3 dB point, retaining phase. Include the reference, repeatability or uncertainty, and conclusions the data cannot support.
